title: Create: K9 Improvements
description: Simple but necessary improvements for K9 mod using Create
body:
A datapack in progress to be able to use the K9 Wrench and Create Mod wrench interchangeably. Currently you can use the Create mod wrench to craft the K9 crate, but more features are coming soon...

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4d8e934f83cf4839a55b1aefd595a123c83f3b8.png)

You may use this datpack in your modpacks, but do not repost without my permission

Check out my other projects at https://modrinth.com/user/Wolfram_24
